rules: Not current-active proof: every candidate requires a new provider check immediately before approval and apply.
No new database copy/snapshot; entries reference existing report proposals without copying historical row values.
Confirm original UUID, current controls, partner/organizer protection and per-field editorial ownership.
Keep complete expected row only in the approved transaction context; do not export a database snapshot.
Approve only individually reviewed fields; do not auto-approve all proposed fields.
Fresh source evidence must be <=5 minutes old at apply; changed facts require renewed approval.
No automatic executor, backfill, outreach or approval is enabled.
